from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
import hashlib, json, re

base = 'https://jobs.wordpress.net/'
root = Path('products/services/wordpress-migration-qa-pilot')
raw = (root / 'raw/jobs-index.html').read_bytes()
expected = '639c8d73be8ffbda25b8f5805a9516956d9744f6d288701e39300884bee4855c'
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == expected, 'Capture differs from TASK-179560800200'

class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.href = None
        self.label = []
        self.listings = {}

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.label = []

    def handle_data(self, value):
        if self.href:
            self.label.append(value)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or not self.href:
            return
        url = urlsplit(urljoin(base, self.href))
        title = ' '.join(' '.join(self.label).split())
        if url.scheme == 'https' and url.netloc == 'jobs.wordpress.net' and re.fullmatch(r'/job/[^/]+/?', url.path) and title:
            self.listings.setdefault(base.rstrip('/') + url.path, title)
        self.href = None

parser = Links()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
terms = re.compile(r'\b(migrat\w*|import\w*|redirect\w*|content|qa|quality|audit\w*)\b', re.I)
listings = [{'url': url, 'title': title} for url, title in parser.listings.items()]
result = {'source': base, 'receipt': 'TASK-179560800200', 'sha256': digest, 'listing_link_count': len(listings), 'keyword_pointers': [item for item in listings if terms.search(item['title'])], 'other_listing_examples': [item for item in listings if not terms.search(item['title'])][:15], 'coverage': 'One static index capture, restricted to labelled same-origin /job/ links. Verify index markup if extraction is empty. Titles do not establish current availability, engagement terms or scope.'}
output = root / 'director-index-screen.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
